page.overview:
Who is Blonde?

Blonde (sometimes referred to as Blondie) is a female Becklespinax seen in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory season one. Blonde is the second Becklespinax seen in the show, her twin sister is nicknamed Brunette. The Becklespinax twins’ names were confirmed via Jurassic World: The Game in a seasonal event.

Blonde is a Becklespinax. Like many of the cloned theropods, she has pronated wrists. She also has large white spines sticking out from the back of her neck, and a small sail on her back. Her body color is mostly olive green with a red face, a yellow neck, and black markings.

Blonde is shown to be more aggressive than Brunette. She often showed hostility toward humans.

Corrupt DPW officials Jared and Jensen released Blonde into the Park County dinosaur free zone. She went on a rampage and killed several people. Ben Pincus and Yasmina Fadoula drove off in Ben's van and Blonde chased after it. When they got to the bridge, the friends had to fend her off long enough for Sammy Gutierrez to get into the van. Blonde is further agitated when Jared and Jensen start firing darts in her direction, causing her to ram the van off of the bridge and fall off into the lake along with it.
